text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"A Classic race, the forerunner of the Tiara line.
The 'Oka Sho' is about to begin shortly."

text_block_list.name: Dober's Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
This day has finally arrived...!
Make sure to firmly seize that first Tiara, Mejiro Dober!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
I bet Mejiro Dober-chan
is going to look so cool today too~.
I can't wait...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Don't let it swallow you up, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What incredible cheering... So this is...
the Classic-tier GⅠ, the Oka Sho...
choice_data_list: You finished the "Hanshin JF," so you'll be just fine.
You ran all the way through the "Hanshin JF," so you'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, yeah.
You've already tasted the atmosphere of a GⅠ, after all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: With the way I am now, I can definitely... fight!
choice_data_list: Let's give it everything we've got

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You don't have to tell me, that was already the plan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'll give it everything I've got.
